# Archival Dispatch: 12 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Jackie Robinson Satchel Paige, Shirley Booth Pilot, and Vincent Price

**Tags**: Jackie Robinson, Satchel Paige, Omar Bradley, Jackie Robinson's Radio Shots, Shirley Booth, Our Miss Brooks, Vincent Price, A Graveyard of Ghost Tales, Wings Over Jordan, Dr. David Dallas Jones, Reichs-Rundfunk-Gesellschaft, Robert H. Best, WWII Propaganda, Bob Elson, Norman Brokenshire, Harry Richman, Stars for Defense, Original Filenames

## Batch 95 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 95 recovers and dates 12 landmark historical broadcasts spanning pioneering African-American sports and civil rights broadcasts, rare unaired sitcom pilot auditions, gothic horror narration, wartime psychological warfare, and travel adventure: Jackie Robinson interviewing legendary Hall of Fame pitcher Leroy 'Satchel' Paige, Five-Star General Omar N. Bradley, and NYRA official starter George Cassidy on ***Jackie Robinson's Radio Shots*** (1959), Oscar and Tony-winning actress Shirley Booth's lost original 1948 audition record as Connie Brooks for ***Our Miss Brooks*** before Eve Arden was cast, Vincent Price reading 'The Magic Candle to Find Hidden Treasure' on ***A Graveyard of Ghost Tales*** (1974), Dr. David Dallas Jones delivering a nationwide address on 'The Place of the Negro Woman in American Life' backed by the renowned choral spirituals of ***Wings Over Jordan*** on CBS (1942), American expatriate traitor Robert H. Best's infamous anti-Allied propaganda broadcast beamed from Berlin on the Nazi *Reichs-Rundfunk-Gesellschaft* (August 1942), pioneer announcer Norman Brokenshire on ***The Armchair Traveler*** (1949), Bob Elson interviewing brewery magnate Rudy Schaeffer on board the *20th Century Limited* (1951), Sonny Burke on ***Stars for Defense*** (1952), Harry Richman on ***It's Florida's Treat*** (1937), and 2 overseas OWI orchestral broadcasts from ***Music from America*** (1944).
